captions.detailed: An amateur astronomical telescope mounted on a robust tripod. The telescope features a long, light-gray cylindrical optical tube assembly with a dew shield, a rear eyepiece holder with an angled diagonal, and mounting rings with a carrying handle. It is supported by a black equatorial mount head that sits atop a black tripod with silver telescoping lower legs and a triangular accessory tray. The optical tube can pivot in elevation, and the mount head allows for panning rotation.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic, detailed astronomical telescope on a tripod. The model should include a long light-gray optical tube with mounting rings, an eyepiece diagonal, a black equatorial mount head, and a three-legged tripod with silver extendable lower legs and a central accessory tray. Ensure appropriate materials are applied to distinguish the metallic tripod legs from the matte black mount and light-gray tube.
captions.factory: The code constructs the telescope using a series of primitives. The tripod legs are created using cylinders angled outward and combined with a thin triangular prism representing the accessory tray. The equatorial mount head is built using a combination of boxes and cylinders. The main optical tube is modeled as a large cylinder, detailed with additional concentric cylinders for the dew shield and eyepiece holder, and a bent cylinder for the star diagonal. Finally, mounting rings and a top handle are constructed from extruded sketches and boxes to secure the tube to the mount.
